## Terms

### TTL Indexes

- **TTL Indexes** · self — TTL indexes automatically delete whole documents after the indexed date plus expireAfterSeconds. They suit bounded-lifetime logs and sessions; expiration depends on the field value, rather than insertion time unless the application stores insertion time there. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-ttl.md
